currency.description: Currency of the items associated with the event, in 3-letter ISO 4217 format. * Value metrics on the view_item event to not contribute to revenue * If you set value then currency is required for revenue metrics to be computed accurately.

value.description: The monetary value of the event. * Set value to the sum of (price * quantity) for all items in items. Don't include shipping or tax. * value is typically required for meaningful reporting. If you mark the event as a key event then it's recommended you set value. * currency is required if you set value.

item_id.description: The ID of the item. *One of item_id or item_name is required.

item_name.description: The name of the item. *One of item_id or item_name is required.

item_variant.description: The item variant or unique code or description for additional item details/options.

item_color.description: Identifies the normalized color selected for the item.
